explanation_result.explanation:
-3.7% day-over-day move (z-score -2.07) on 2021-07-19. Reasons given by 2 reports from that day:
- "Peabirus : Com delta , dólar e petróleo no radar , arábica acompanha demais commodities e recua forte nesta 2ª" (redepeabirus.com.br, 2021-07-19). Reported move: down, size not stated. Reason: Com delta, dólar e petróleo no radar. Quote: "Com delta, dólar e petróleo no radar" (source: 13efcc986a76e8a9)
- "Café e acar recuam em meio à venda generalizada de petróleo e aes" (istoe.com.br, 2021-07-19). Reported move: down 3.1%. Reason: preços do petróleo recuando. Quote: "com ações globais e os preços do petróleo recuando devido ao aumento de casos de Covid-19" (source: 8dbefb4ae9191d93)
Pointing the other way, 2 reports from that day:
- "Peabirus : # CAFÉ : Problemas de embarque e frio no Brasil influenciaram alta no mercado" (redepeabirus.com.br, 2021-07-19). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: Problemas de embarque e frio no Brasil. Quote: "#CAFÉ: Problemas de embarque e frio no Brasil influenciaram alta no mercado" (source: ac91c321d3b67720)
- "El café sube en Brasil y Colombia , se traslada al país" (elliberal.com.ar, 2021-07-19). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: drought in Brazil and social tensions in Colombia. Quote: "Una gran sequía en Brasil, donde la cosecha 2021 cayó más de 20% respecto de 2020" (source: 33dda18e3ad4ad97)
